record.question: Bar charts are suitable for -
record.explanation: Bar/Gantt charts can be used to plan or track projects of all sizes, from minor works to large projects. Large complex projects may additionally need dependency/critical-path analysis, but that does not make bar charts unsuitable; all the listed work sizes can use them. Reference: https://www.apm.org.uk/resources/find-a-resource/gantt-chart/; https://learninglab.rmit.edu.au/Toolbox/buildright/content/bcgbc4007a/03_develop_track_revise/05_bar_gantt_charts/page_001.htm. Original printed source and ordered choices independently reviewed. Verified worked solution, unofficial; no matching examiner key is asserted.
